indicators.title: Coverage of HPV-vaccine, girls
indicators.label: HPV vaccination · girls, two doses by age 13
indicators.note: Girls turning 13 in the reporting year who received two HPV doses during the preceding two school years. The API total series is the total within this girls-only indicator, not both sexes. Vaccination coverage is a supporting prevention indicator, not a count of cancers prevented.

indicators.title: Coverage of HPV-vaccine, boys
indicators.label: HPV vaccination · boys, two doses by age 13
indicators.note: Boys turning 13 in the reporting year who received two HPV doses during the preceding two school years. The API total series is the total within this boys-only indicator, not both sexes. Small cells may be withheld. Vaccination coverage does not measure cancers prevented.

indicators.title: Daily smokers (%)
indicators.label: Daily smoking · age 20+
indicators.note: Self-reported daily smoking among people aged 20 and over. Survey estimates use nonresponse weights; uncertainty and coverage affect comparisons. This is a supporting risk-factor indicator, not a count of preventable cancer cases.

indicators.title: Persons who drink too much alcohol (AUDIT-C) (%)
indicators.label: Excess alcohol use (AUDIT-C) · alcohol users age 20+
indicators.note: AUDIT-C probable excess use among alcohol users aged 20 and over. Thresholds differ by age and sex. These are self-reported, weighted survey estimates. The denominator is alcohol users, not all residents; this is not a count of preventable cancers.
